verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch has several many-at-once mechanisms. A Bulk edit mode lets you add or modify many request parameters at once (docs-38). Collection-level headers and auth apply to every request in that collection (docs-4). It supports simultaneous imports of collections and environments (docs-33), and the CLI runs entire collections (docs-8, docs-9). An official MCP server also lets an agent read and change collections and requests (docs-32), but the pack does not say whether it can do so in batches. Missing for 10: documented multi-select bulk edit/delete/move of requests or collections, explicit batch operations through the MCP server or CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
